q: Oseledets' multiplicative ergodic theorem (1968) for a measurable cocycle A: X → GL(d,ℝ) over an ergodic MPT T asserts the existence of a T-invariant measurable splitting ℝ^d = E₁(x) ⊕ ... ⊕ Eₖ(x) and numbers λ₁ > ... > λₖ such that for vectors v ∈ Eᵢ(x):
opts: The splitting is constant in x
exp: Oseledets MET: for a.e. x, the Lyapunov exponent lim (1/n)log||A^n(x)v|| = λᵢ for all v ∈ Eᵢ(x)\{0}. This is the ergodic theorem for matrix products. The splitting Eᵢ(x) is measurable, T-equivariant, and the exponents are deterministic constants (Lyapunov exponents).
